newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained steady on Saturday as mill owners kept to the sidelines on hopes that increased supplies from Punjab province would depress prices, dealers said.

"Experts say that the danger to the cotton crop because of the white flies has receded after rains in Punjab," dealer Kishan Chand said. "Arrival have already picked up. People expect good crops this year and expect prices to slide."
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at around 2,075 ($55.99) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
